description: This is a PHP source file defining the EditView class, responsible for rendering and handling an edit view form in the SuiteCRM system. It manages form setup, rendering, population of beans from requests, and integrates with Smarty templates for display.

classes.name: EditView
classes.description: Class responsible for rendering and processing the edit view form in SuiteCRM, including setup, population, rendering, and integration with Smarty templates.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the EditView object with module, focus bean, metadata, template, and other configurations.

methods.name: createFocus
methods.description: Creates a new focus bean instance if it doesn't already exist, based on module and bean definitions.

methods.name: populateBean
methods.description: Populates the focus bean with data from the request or $_REQUEST.

methods.name: requiredFirst
methods.description: Reorders panels to place required fields first.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Prepares view definitions, calculates widths, and prepares panels for rendering.

methods.name: getPanelWithFillers
methods.description: Adds filler fields to panels to ensure proper alignment.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Processes the form, manages navigation parameters, and prepares data for display.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Assigns Smarty variables and outputs the rendered template, managing scripts, styles, and form parameters.

methods.name: insertJavascript
methods.description: Inserts custom JavaScript into the Smarty template.

methods.name: callFunction
methods.description: Executes a custom function defined in field definitions and returns its value.

methods.name: getValueFromRequest
methods.description: Extracts and unformats a field value from the HTTP request.

methods.name: showTitle
methods.description: Returns custom module title if view object is available.

methods.name: getTemplateHandler
methods.description: Returns a new instance of the TemplateHandler.
